subject: Solution partner listing: commercial split, metering, and launch checklist
messages:
From: Emma Hart <emma.hart@stratusone.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace@stratusone.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing prep & co-sell economics

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — excited to move the StratusOne listing forward. To get us to a viable co-sell launch with AWS and Redwood we need to sync on three quick items so I can assemble the listing packet for AWS: 

1) Commercial: proposed revenue split and who owns lead routing. We've sketched a 70/30 (StratusOne/Redwood) for referral deals but are flexible. Please confirm Redwood's preferred split and any minimum ARR threshold for co-sell.

2) Technical evidence: short guide on metering SKU(s), consumption metering expectations, and a contact for metering verification. AWS requires implementation notes + a test metered SKU.

3) Launch ops: proposed kickoff date (we're targeting Nov 8), enablement slots for seller training, and DocuSign for the co-sell addendum.

I've attached our internal co-sell proposal (draft) and will upload an AWS checklist once we have your SKU details. Can you loop in finance/legal folks who own rev-share approvals and contractual sign-off?

Best,
Emma
Emma Hart | Head of Partnerships, StratusOne
T: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: co-sell-rev-share-proposal.pdf (draft)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emma Hart <emma.hart@stratusone.com>, marketplace@stratusone.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing prep & co-sell economics

Emma — thanks, this is clear and actionable. Looping in Vanessa (channel/alliances) and Ben (go-to-market) to confirm commercial and enablement. High-level replies below and next steps: 

- Commercial: 65/35 (StratusOne/Redwood) for direct-sourced co-sell deals is our typical starting point for solution partners integrated into the Redwood hosted offering. We can entertain 70/30 if StratusOne commits to a 12-month enablement plan and minimum $150k ARR within the first 12 months. Vanessa — can you confirm if that flexibility is ok?

- Metering SKU: we need to map two SKUs — one for managed Hosted API usage and one for Dedicated reservations (if you plan to sell Reserved capacity). Please share the dimensions (unit = token / embedding / seats) and any tier thresholds. We'll hand this to our billing team and provide a metering-spec doc.

- Launch ops: Nov 8 capacity is reasonable but tight. Suggest Nov 15 to give legal time for the co-sell addendum sign-off. Ben — can you propose 2 enablement slots the week of Nov 16?

Action items: 
1) Emma: send SKU mapping and test metering plan (by EOD Mon).
2) Vanessa: confirm commercial flexibility (65/35 -> 70/30 conditional).
3) Ben: propose enablement times and seller invite list.
4) I'll pull in Legal (Olga) for contract redlines.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Strategic Alliances | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Emma Hart <emma.hart@stratusone.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 12:10:00 -07:00

Karthik / Emma — quick confirmation from my side: 70/30 is OK under the conditions Karthik outlined (12-month enablement and $150k ARR commitment). We should document it as a conditional term in the co-sell addendum so AWS can surface the metadata.

Also, for metering: Ben, please coordinate with Emma on whether StratusOne expects per-token billing or packaged units — that affects how we present SKUs in the marketplace catalog. I'm attaching our internal seller guide excerpt that explains SKU types and common patterns.

Vanessa
Director, Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: aws-seller-guide.docx
